contract_name: MediScanAI Emergency Triage Guardrail Integration Contract

query.description: Normalized user query string or concatenated speech transcription.

baseline_response.description: The raw generated markdown response from the LLM generator (required for post-generation stage).

retrieved_contexts.description: Optional list of retrieved disease or drug evidence summaries used for Rule-06 intercept.

ocr_text.description: Optional extracted OCR packaging text from user-uploaded images.

router_signals.description: Optional structured intent router signals (e.g., query_type, target_entity, confidence).

guarded_response.description: Final user-facing response. Exactly equals baseline_response if no emergency fired; replaced with emergency escalation template if fired.

is_emergency.description: True if an acute emergency trigger or evidence intercept fired.

fired_rule_id.description: Unique identifier of the rule that fired (e.g., RULE-01-CARDIOVASCULAR-CHEST-PAIN).

matched_text.description: Substring from the query or context that satisfied the regex pattern.

reasoning.description: Deterministic rationale for the triage decision.

response_modified.description: Indicates whether the response string was mutated by the guardrail.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock execution duration of guardrail evaluation in milliseconds.

idempotency.description: Applying apply_guardrail multiple times produces identical text without duplicate headers or nested warnings.

data_minimization_rules: Never log full raw user symptom text to production application logs by default.
Never log raw LLM generation text or guarded response text into stdout / stderr.
Only record structured audit metadata: rule_id, category, severity, is_emergency, latency_ms, analysis_id, and hashed query fingerprint.
Retain full text only in designated, cryptographically secured offline evaluation sets under explicit IRB / clinical audit controls.
